question: Can a versioned production batch decomposition path recover the same point-decomposition witnesses and full IC answers while delivering at least a 50x paired wall-time speedup over legacy rootfind-mitm and no regression versus rootfind-subtract on the frozen ordinary p31 curve?

claims.text: On the frozen ordinary p31 workload, the versioned production batch arm is at least 50x faster than legacy rootfind-mitm in paired full-pipeline L2 wall time and is faster than rootfind-subtract outside the matched A/A noise band.
claims.if_supported: The 50x engineering goal is met for this frozen p31 production workload only.
claims.if_not_supported: The 50x goal is not met; report the observed ratio and continue optimization without widening the claim.

claims.text: Every admitted candidate row independently verifies the recovered ECDLP answer, the versioned arm reports honest batch-call/target/unused counters, and the preflight integration suite establishes scalar/batch witness and charged-work parity on a real prime-field curve.
The p61 oracle panel is a full-width diagnostic control, not an admitted end-to-end IC speed claim; a p61 full pipeline at the frozen factor-base scale is outside scope.
The Lean declarations prove only the semantic finite-domain direct-subtraction refinement and do not verify Rust, IFMA, Bloom filters, accounting, CNF compilation, or a SAT solver implementation.

hypotheses.statement: Eight-target shared-inversion decomposition reduces native point-decomposition work enough to exceed the legacy MITM table/probe path by 50x without losing the incumbent subtract path on the frozen p31 production pipeline.
hypotheses.mechanism: The versioned batch arm amortizes inversion and uses a lane kernel while preserving target order, witness verification and an honestly charged post-hit full sweep.

predictions.minimum_effect: median paired legacy wall_ns / batch wall_ns >= 50.0

data_seen.measured: Historical prototype and production measurements were read; they are shared-host [pcc:unverified] and not part of this sample.

provenance.decisive_scope: Only the new EKS L2 rows are decisive; all prior timing is calibration context.

predictions.minimum_effect: median paired subtract wall_ns / batch wall_ns strictly exceeds max_i max(legacy_i/legacy_aa_i, legacy_aa_i/legacy_i)

provenance.decisive_scope: Frozen p31 EKS L2 rows only.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Each production row is a known public ECDLP target with mandatory independent [d]G=Q verification; no absence/detector claim is made.

negative.not_applicable_reason: The production claim never treats a decomposition miss as evidence; reference-negative diagnostics are outside this EKS protocol.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: All five ecbench arms use one exact source revision, binary digest, build flags and one thread.

factors.name: arm order
factors.how: ecbench uses the frozen alternate_measured order so each arm occupies multiple order positions.

factors.name: target inputs
factors.how: Each comparison receives the same public target stream and seeds.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Accepted rows record EKS worker, CPU, isolation, scheduler, steal and pressure facts.

factors.name: cache and layout
factors.how: Every measured ecbench round is a fresh process/arm execution under the native harness.

factors.name: factor-base size
factors.how: Every accepted p31 production arm uses the same 640-abscissa factor base.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Analysis is unblinded because method identities are explicit; all raw samples and unfavorable rows are retained.

median paired reference/candidate ratio strictly exceeds max_i max(legacy_i/legacy_aa_i, legacy_aa_i/legacy_i)

comparisons.reason: Exact ECDLP verification and batch-ledger checks are evaluated per production row and are not collapsed into a speed comparison.

transfer_obligations.obligation: No transfer is claimed. p61 remains a full-width scalar diagnostic until a dedicated admitted microbenchmark contract exists.

randomization.arm_order_reason: The accepted spec uses alternate_measured, placing each production arm in multiple order positions.

seed_derivation.note: ecbench uses measurement seed 59297, measured-index algorithm seeds and target seed 20261126.

instance_sampling.rule: The accepted workload is the single frozen explicit p31 curve for every arm.

blinding.how: Method labels remain visible; the fixed thresholds, raw-sample retention and frozen analysis definitions constrain analyst discretion.

power.note: Six paired L2 rounds are the fixed EKS design and exceed the native five-round admission minimum. No significance or power claim is made: the preregistered decision is descriptive threshold arithmetic, and the bootstrap interval is descriptive only.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative workflow and provisioning estimate based on the frozen per-method timeout; no affected p31 production-panel run was inspected before this draft.

primary.name: Paired full-pipeline speedup versus legacy MITM
primary.definition: Within each measured EKS round, legacy-mitm method_call_wall_ns divided by floor-batch-v1 method_call_wall_ns; warmup excluded; complete verified rows only; no ratio of independent medians.
primary.resolution: one nanosecond in each source clock

primary.name: Paired full-pipeline speedup versus subtract
primary.definition: Within each measured EKS round, subtract-scalar method_call_wall_ns divided by floor-batch-v1 method_call_wall_ns; warmup excluded; complete verified rows only.
primary.resolution: one nanosecond in each source clock

secondary.name: Full method wall time
secondary.definition: Wall time from ecbench method entry through verified method return for one arm/workload row.

secondary.name: Counted pipeline group-addition equivalents
secondary.definition: All priced counted group operations across factor base, oracle setup, relations, linear algebra and verification; native unpriced counters remain separately disclosed.

secondary.name: Witness and ledger validation
secondary.definition: Every production row verifies [d]G=Q; the batch arm alone emits preferred/actual-width, call, target and unused-work counters satisfying the frozen analyzer's structural checks.
secondary.source: native ecbench audit and relations-phase native counters

record: source commit, ecbench SHA-256, OCI image digest and spec SHA-256
Job and Pod UIDs plus S3 results URI and payload hashes
CPU model, CPU flags, kernel, governor, SMT, NUMA, affinity and run CPU
isolation level and blockers, steal, PSI, foreign busy ticks and scheduler observations
arm order, measured round, target and algorithm seeds, exit status and rusage
factor-base identity, curve identity, witness/cost records and replay/audit verdicts
measurement.timed_primary_justification: The optimization changes native field arithmetic, batched inversion and SIMD work that group-operation counts do not price comparably. Only L2 rows admitted by the native replay and A/A gate may support the paired clock ratios.

stopping_rules.rule: Run exactly one warmup and six measured rounds for every accepted arm; do not stop early for a favorable ratio.

A correctness failure, replay failure, any row below L2, A/A rejection, source/build mismatch, timeout or nonzero exit makes the experiment unsuccessful and is retained; it is not retried as a measurement.
Do not launch if Git publication, checkpoint, pool, budget or benchmark-record gates fail or if the remaining daily/monthly cost allowance is unknown.

decision_rule.text: Support the production-speedup claim only if every candidate row verifies, the EKS result passes native all-record L2/replay/A-A/S3 admission, median paired legacy/batch speedup is at least 50.0 and strictly exceeds the symmetric A/A upper bound, and median paired subtract/batch speedup strictly exceeds that same bound. The symmetric bound is max_i max(legacy_i/legacy_aa_i, legacy_aa_i/legacy_i). Otherwise report the goal as unmet at the observed scope.
decision_rule.threshold: legacy/batch median >= 50.0 and > symmetric A/A upper bound; subtract/batch median > the same bound; exact correctness
decision_rule.statistic: Median of within-round paired ratios, with all raw pairs retained; paired bootstrap CI95 is descriptive at fixed N=6.
decision_rule.interval: Paired bootstrap 95% interval plus the empirical legacy/legacy A/A ratio range.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Reference wall_ns divided by candidate wall_ns; values above one favor the candidate.

inputs: complete native ecbench records.jsonl (input to analyze.py)
native audit/replay/A-A admission receipt (external mandatory final-verdict gate)
isolab source/build/image/spec receipt and S3 SHA256SUMS (external mandatory final-verdict gate)
outputs: rootfind-production-analysis/v1 with every raw paired ratio and a timing-only threshold verdict

inadmissible: A standalone shared-host or command-Job diagnostic timing is not accepted EKS L2 evidence.
A p61 diagnostic is not a p61 end-to-end IC speedup claim.
A reference-negative target is not a completeness-certified unsatisfiable target.
A ratio of independent medians, best-of repeat, favorable seed, truncated row set or changed hit/miss mix is not a paired speedup.
Changing seeds, rounds, factor-base size, accounting, identity, unit, timeout or decision threshold after reading affected data is forbidden without a prospective amendment.
The historical four-thread prototype comparison and all shared-host numbers remain [pcc:unverified].
The semantic Lean theorem cannot be presented as verification of the Rust implementation, SIMD arithmetic, accounting, compiler, CNF generator or SAT solver.
